agentTools.name: list_resources
agentTools.title: List Projector resources
agentTools.description: Searches Projector resource summaries by optional query string (people catalog). Human “list users” maps here. Returns truncated lists with resource_links and searchCoverage (status full/partial; when partial, do not present as complete — follow suggestion). Does not return schedules or timecards.
agentTools.whenNotToUse: Do not use to resolve a single person by email/resource_id/full name; prefer get_resource with resource_id, full_name, or email.

agentTools.name: get_resource
agentTools.title: Get Projector resource
agentTools.description: Gets one Projector resource (a person's profile). Provide one of: resource_id (ResourceReferenceSystemId or ResourceUid, preferred/fastest), full_name (exact display name, preferred/fast), or email (slower — uses resource list search then detail). There is no lookup of the signed-in user: their own time cards, schedule and PTO need no resource id (omit resource_id on list_timecards, get_schedule, list_upcoming_pto). Optionally includes history and UDFs. Human “user” maps here. Does not return timecards.
agentTools.whenNotToUse: Do not use for timecards, schedules, or multi-person search lists (use list_resources / list_timecards).

resource_id.description: Preferred. ResourceReferenceSystemId or ResourceUid. Fast single PwsGetResource call. Do not pass email or display name here.

full_name.description: Preferred. Exact ResourceDisplayName (e.g. "Jane Doe"). Fast single PwsGetResource call. Prefer over email.

email.description: Person email address. Slower than resource_id/full_name — resolves via PwsGetResourceList then PwsGetResource. Prefer resource_id or full_name when known.

agentTools.name: list_timecards
agentTools.title: List Projector timecards
agentTools.description: Lists many work timecard rows for one person (default: the signed-in user) in a date range, in every status including Rejected, with optional status, project_code and query filters. Does not include time-off cards. Each card has the task name, taskPath (parent tasks > task) and taskWbsCode, plus timecardUid, projectTaskUid, projectRoleUid and projectRateTypeUid for save_timecard updates. Does not infer expected workdays; pair with get_schedule if you need utilization-basis days vs cards. Includes searchCoverage (status full/partial; when partial, do not present as complete). The signed-in user's own cards have editable: true = Draft or Rejected (save_timecard can change them), false = fix in Projector. by_date gives posted hours per day (and per status), so days can be compared with get_schedule's expected hours without adding cards up.
agentTools.whenNotToUse: Do not use for capacity or bookings; use check_availability or get_schedule. Do not use for PTO cards; use list_time_off.

resource_id.description: Optional person: resource id, full name or e-mail. Omit (or "me") for the signed-in user.

query.description: Optional words to find in the card description, project, client, task path or WBS (whole words or word starts, e.g. "invoice export" or a ticket number)

compact.description: true = short cards (date, hours, project, task path, WBS, role, rate type, status, description, timecardUid, editable); use it for history reads

agentTools.name: get_schedule
agentTools.title: Get Projector resource schedule
agentTools.description: Returns the schedule of one person (default: the signed-in user) for a date window: working/utilization minutes and hours, holidays, PTO, roles (with engagement/client/managers/stage), bookings (dailyWeeklyFlag D/W plus schedulingMode daily/weekly, with notes), plus daily/weekly capacity summaries (state, booked/available minutes). Cap is eight weeks. Prefer check_availability for multi-person capacity questions. Booked minutes are planned resource bookings (the resource plan), not time posted on timecards; use list_timecards for posted hours.
agentTools.whenNotToUse: Do not use for multi-person availability comparisons. Do not use for historical time entry totals; use list_timecards. Do not use for a project team roster; use list_project_roles. Do not use for project booked hours across teammates; use list_proj_bookings.

resource_id.description: Optional person: resource id, full name or e-mail. Omit (or "me") for the signed-in user.

agentTools.name: check_availability
agentTools.title: Check Projector availability
agentTools.description: Compares capacity and bookings for 1–20 people over a date window using utilization-basis minutes. Returns weekly available minutes/hours, project/role bookings, PTO/holidays, and whether each person can take the requested weekly hours. people defaults to the signed-in user; without required_hours_per_week the result shows capacity only. Daily availability.days is omitted unless show_availability_days is true. Includes searchCoverage (status partial when any person fails). Does not return resource history or actual timecards.
agentTools.whenNotToUse: Do not use for historical time entry totals; use list_timecards. Do not use to list assigned projects only; use get_schedule (or a bookings-shaped wrapper).

people.description: Emails, display names, or system ids; omit (or "me") for the signed-in user

resource_id.description: Optional ResourceReferenceSystemId alias for people (merged into the people list)

show_availability_days.description: When true, include daily availability.days in addition to weeks. Default weekly only.

agentTools.name: list_time_off
agentTools.title: List Projector time-off cards
agentTools.description: Lists many PwsGetTimeCards time-off card rows for one person (default: the signed-in user) and date range. Holidays and bookings live on the schedule; company holiday calendars are list_holidays; company-wide ASMX scheduled-timeoff export is ops-only. Includes searchCoverage (status full/partial).
agentTools.whenNotToUse: Use list_upcoming_pto for a combined schedule+cards window. Use list_holidays for company-wide location holiday calendars. Do not use for work time entries; use list_timecards.

resource_id.description: Optional person: resource id, full name or e-mail. Omit (or "me") for the signed-in user.

agentTools.name: list_engagements
agentTools.title: List Projector engagements
agentTools.description: Lists engagements with engagement manager plus nested projects including project manager, stage, begin date, and end date. Query uses Projector’s fast server search for engagement, client, contract line item, and project fields. ManagerQuery searches engagement/project manager name or email and defaults to open engagements unless include_closed is set. has_more means page again with next_offset; searchCoverage.status=partial (complete=false) means Projector capped its own list, so count is only a lower bound — never present a capped manager search as someone’s complete project list; follow searchCoverage.suggestion. Includes execution duration. Does not return dollar budgets.
agentTools.whenNotToUse: Use get_engagement for one engagement’s billable/productive flags, cost center, and contracts.

query.description: Fast server-side search across engagement, client, contract line item, and nested project code/name fields. If there are no server matches, it falls back to manager name/email search.

manager_query.description: Case-insensitive substring search over engagement manager display name/email and project manager display name. Combine with query to narrow candidates server-side. When set and include_closed is omitted, only open engagements are searched.

manager_role.description: Limits manager_query (or automatic manager fallback) to engagement managers, project managers, or either.

include_closed.description: Include closed engagements. Defaults to true for ordinary listing and to false when manager_query is set and this flag is omitted. Pass true to search closed history by manager.

agentTools.name: get_engagement
agentTools.title: Get Projector engagement
agentTools.description: Gets one engagement by code with engagement manager, billable/productive flags, cost center, contracts, nested projects including project manager, and planned hour/money budgets when the signed-in user's Projector permissions include them. Money budget fields may be omitted (never treat missing money as $0). Does not compare actuals to budget.
agentTools.whenNotToUse: Do not use for resource schedules or timecards; use get_schedule or list_timecards. Do not use for company-wide over-budget lists.

agentTools.name: list_upcoming_pto
agentTools.title: List upcoming Projector PTO
agentTools.description: Lists upcoming PTO for one person (default: the signed-in user) by combining schedule holidays/PTO and time-off cards in a window up to 366 days (default today through about the third Friday). Each pto row includes minutes and hours (minutes / 60). Includes searchCoverage (status full/partial). Projector-only; no Bamboo or email.
agentTools.whenNotToUse: Do not use for company-wide holiday calendars; use list_holidays. Do not use for company-wide ASMX scheduled-timeoff exports. Prefer list_time_off when you only need cards for an explicit date range.

resource_id.description: Optional person: resource id, full name or e-mail. Omit (or "me") for the signed-in user.

agentTools.name: get_overview
agentTools.title: Get Projector resource overview
agentTools.description: Returns a bounded bundle of resource profile, timecards, schedule/bookings/roles, and time off for one resource. Prefer this instead of chaining four primitives. The date window is at most 120 days.
agentTools.whenNotToUse: Do not use for simple availability checks; use check_availability.

resource_id.description: Person: resource id, full name or e-mail

end_date.description: Inclusive end date; at most 120 days after start_date

agentTools.name: list_holidays
agentTools.title: List Projector holiday calendars
agentTools.description: Lists company holiday calendars by location for an inclusive date range. Returns compact calendars (location + holiday dates/names), not per-person rows. end_date defaults to start_date plus three months when omitted. Optional location is a case-insensitive substring of Projector LocationName (Canada matches CA - Canada). Includes searchCoverage (status full/partial). Prefer get_schedule or list_upcoming_pto for one resource.
agentTools.whenNotToUse: Do not use for one person's holidays, PTO, or bookings; use get_schedule or list_upcoming_pto. Do not use for company-wide scheduled PTO cards; use ops list_scheduled_timeoff.

end_date.description: Inclusive end date. Defaults to start_date plus three months when omitted.

location.description: Optional case-insensitive substring of Projector LocationName (e.g. Canada matches CA - Canada).

agentTools.name: list_project_roles
agentTools.title: List Projector project roles
agentTools.description: Lists many booked/assigned project role rows for one or more project codes (role name, resource id/name, optional email). Uses PwsGetProjectRoles Mode=A. Does not return date-window booked hours. Includes searchCoverage (status full/partial; when partial, do not present as complete).
agentTools.whenNotToUse: Do not use for October-style booked hours; use list_proj_bookings. Do not use for one person's assigned projects; use get_schedule. Do not use for capacity; use check_availability.

project_code.description: One project code or 1–100 project codes (e.g. P001234-001).

agentTools.name: list_proj_bookings
agentTools.title: List Projector project bookings
agentTools.description: Lists many booked-hour rows for one or more project codes in an inclusive date window (role, resource, date, scheduled minutes/hours). Uses PwsGetResourceSchedulingRoleData mode A; one SOAP call per project with bounded concurrency. Zero-hour buckets are omitted. Accepts many project_codes in one MCP call. Includes searchCoverage (status full/partial; honor partial coverage — do not invent missing projects).
agentTools.whenNotToUse: Do not use for assignment roster without hours; use list_project_roles. Do not use for one person's load; use get_schedule. Do not use for actual timecards; use list_timecards.

project_code.description: One project code or 1–100 project codes.

agentTools.name: list_time_projects
agentTools.title: List projects I can enter time on
agentTools.description: Lists many projects the signed-in user can enter time on for one work_date (PwsSearchProjects, ListType=T, available projects only), with the user's roles on each. Always the signed-in user's own time sheet; no resource parameter. Optional query matches whole words or word starts of the project, engagement or client (best match first). The query filters the user's full project list in memory (cached per user for a few minutes); page with offset. chargeable is false where the user has no role on the project (Projector refuses time there). By default only chargeable projects are listed (not_chargeable_hidden counts the rest); chargeable_only = false shows them too. Each project shows the user's use in the last 30 days (last_used, hours_last_30d, recent_tasks), most recent first; query also matches recent task names (matched_tasks).
agentTools.whenNotToUse: Do not use to browse engagements or a manager's projects; use list_engagements. Do not use for who is staffed on a project; use list_project_roles.

work_date.description: Work date (yyyy-MM-dd) the time is for

query.description: Optional text to match project, engagement or client (whole words or word starts)

offset.description: Rows to skip; use next_offset from the previous page

chargeable_only.description: true (default): only projects where you have a role and can post time; false: also the others

agentTools.name: get_timecard_options
agentTools.title: Get time entry options for a project
agentTools.description: Gets one project's time-entry options for the signed-in user on one work_date (PwsGetTimeEntryProjectRole + PwsSearchProjects + PwsGetTimeEntryParameters, cached per user for a few minutes): only tasks open for time, each with task_path (parent tasks > task) and WBS code, the user's roles, and entry rules (time increment, location, UDFs). Rate types are for information only (the ones most tasks allow are listed once as rate_types; a task lists its own only when they differ): save_timecard always uses the task's default_rate_type, so don't offer rate type choices. Task names repeat under different parents, so filter with query (task name, WBS code or parent name) and page with max_tasks/offset. Call before save_timecard. Summary tasks (tasks with sub-tasks) are never listed, because Projector rejects time on them at submit (tasks_summary_hidden counts them). On projects where only people assigned to a task may post time, each task has assigned (true/false) and assignment_note explains it; save_timecard refuses assigned = false.
agentTools.whenNotToUse: Do not use to find the user's projects; use list_time_projects. Do not use for a project's staffing roster; use list_project_roles.

work_date.description: Work date (yyyy-MM-dd) the time is for

query.description: Optional text to match task name, task path (parent names) or WBS code (whole words or word starts)

offset.description: Tasks to skip; use tasks_next_offset from the previous page

agentTools.name: save_timecard
agentTools.title: Save my Projector time card (draft)
agentTools.description: Saves 1–20 work time cards on the signed-in user's own time sheet in one call (PwsSaveTimeCards per card, SubmitFlag=false): each card is created as Draft, or updates one of the user's own Draft or Rejected cards when its timecard_uid is given. Never submits, approves or deletes; no resource parameter. Show the user every card and get one confirmation, then send all approved cards in one call. Every card is checked first (task, role, hours, summary tasks, tasks the user is not assigned to, duplicates): invalid cards are reported and not sent, valid ones are saved one by one and never retried; after an unknown outcome the remaining cards are not attempted. The rate type is always the task's default. dry_run = true checks everything and shows the day totals without saving.
agentTools.whenNotToUse: Do not use to read cards; use list_timecards. Do not use for time off; it writes work time only.

cards.description: The cards to save (1–20), in the order the user approved them

work_date.description: Work date (yyyy-MM-dd). On update, the card's current work date.

hours.description: Hours worked, in the account's time increment (e.g. 0.25 steps)

task.description: WBS code (preferred), task UID, task_path or unique task name (get_timecard_options)

role.description: Role UID or exact role name

timecard_uid.description: Only to update: timecardUid from list_timecards

dry_run.description: true: check every card and show the day totals, but save nothing

opsTools.name: list_scheduled_timeoff
opsTools.title: Export scheduled time off (ASMX)
opsTools.description: Company-wide ASMX ExportScheduledTimeoff for an inclusive date range. Prefer list_time_off or list_upcoming_pto for one resource. Company holiday calendars are list_holidays.
